movements.label: 2. Er, der Herrlichste von allen — Innig, lebhaft
3. Ich kann's nicht fassen, nicht glauben — Mit Leidenschaft
4. Du Ring an meinem Finger — Innig
5. Helft mir, ihr Schwestern — Ziemlich schnell
6. Süßer Freund, du blickest — Langsam, mit innigem Ausdruck
7. An meinem Herzen, an meiner Brust — Fröhlich, innig
8. Nun hast du mir den ersten Schmerz getan — Adagio

sourceObservations: All sixteen source pages inspected. Complete eight-song cycle, 77 systems, voice plus piano grand staff in every system, including printed vocal rests in postludes. Preserve lyrics, piano pedal directions, ledger bass, high slurs, all shared tempi. The two printed directions Noch schneller and Presto remain distinct. Page 10 system 4 has ritard/a tempo printed in both parts already.

independentCropReview.method: Every output strip compared with original source context extending beyond both crop edges; all77 vocal and77 piano systems. All12 separate shared marking source rectangles compared against their output. Neighbors accepted. Protected source envelopes supplement musical inspection.
observations: All eight songs represented through printed final rests, double bars and fermatas; empty vocal postlude staves retained.
Original large song numbers partly intersect crop edges; numbered editorial section labels preserve section identity.
Low piano ledger chords, bass slurs and inverted fermatas on p2s2, p16s2 and p16s4 inspected with clearance.
German lyric descenders, grace notes, turn ornaments, hairpins and tempo words inspected in all77 vocal systems.
All12 isolated shared directions complete: Lebhafter, ritard., Adagio, Presto, Langsamer, Tempo wie das erste Lied, Etwas langsamer, Nach und nach rascher, Schneller/a tempo and Noch schneller.

finalEdgeReinspection.method: Original unmasked source context at 2.4x with final crop and previous guard overlay; all target notation retained. Guard margin tightened only after visual review; no crop changes.

independentCropReview.finalReviewMethod: All source bands compared with outside-edge original context; all final exported pages viewed at 120 dpi for layout, reading scale, source order, headings, shared cues and footer clearance. Final v7 geometry changes reviewed separately; no target ink loss found.
independentCropReview.performancePageTurns: System-boundary pagination and section starts checked; practical turning opportunities were not optimized.
